title: Decomposition into coordinate juntas
statement: Let $\Omega$ be any type, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on $\Omega^n$. Then $f$ can be written as a sum indexed by subsets $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, where each summand depends only on the coordinates in its indexing set $J$.
